controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, the Company has approximately 435 of such suits involving approximately 445 plaintiffs ... punitive damages in these cases are generally capped at $250,000 per claimant, unless the plaintiff can prove that the Company acted ... with a specific intent to cause harm, which the court to date has cast as a jury issue, meaning that the jury could negate the cap.

controles.verbatim_source: Operating Income 663 739 1,225 1,405 / Net Income $449 $1,185 / (Loss) Income from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax (276) 430 / Goodwill 25,944 ; Developed Technology, Net 5,661 ; Customer Relationships, Net 1,912 ; Other Intangibles, Net 448 ; Total Assets $50,731 / The decrease in the carrying value as of June 30, 2026 included $134 million of non-cash asset impairment charges
controles.correction_proposee: Ecart de 1 M$ sur les incorporels nets (8 021 et non 8 020) ; sans incidence sur le ratio de 67%.

controles.affirmation: La progression du FCF sur neuf mois (1 728 M$ vs 1 195 M$) est portee par la distribution exceptionnelle de tresorerie de 3 857 M$ recue lors de la scission Waters, pas par une amelioration recurrente de l'activite
controles.verbatim_source: Financing Activities ... Distribution from spin-off entity, net (see Note 2) | 3,857 | - | ... Net Cash Provided by Continuing Operating Activities | 2,104 | 1,578 | ... Capital expenditures | (376) | (383)
controles.correction_proposee: La distribution de 3 857 M$ est classee en activites de FINANCEMENT et n'entre donc pas dans le FCF. Le FCF passe de 1 195 a 1 728 M$ uniquement parce que le cash operationnel des activites poursuivies passe de 1 578 a 2 104 M$ (variation favorable du BFR : -542 contre -920). Reformuler : 'la hausse du FCF sur neuf mois vient d'une moindre consommation de besoin en fonds de roulement, et non de la distribution Waters qui est enregistree en financement'.

controles.affirmation: L'ecart de plus de 23 points entre la marge de segment agregee (36,8%) et la marge operationnelle consolidee (13,3%) vient des couts d'integration et de restructuration et des charges corporate non allouees, 'en grande partie lies a la scission Waters' (hook et bloc quantitatif)
controles.verbatim_source: Segment Operating Income $1,835 ... Unallocated items : Net interest expense (128) ; Corporate administrative and other unallocated (a) (616) ; Purchase accounting adjustments (b) (363) ; Integration, restructuring and transaction expense (89) ; Product, litigation, and other items (c) (53) ; Separation-related items (d) (32)
controles.correction_proposee: Sur les 1 172 M$ d'ecart au T3, seuls 89 M$ d'integration/restructuration et 32 M$ de separation-related items peuvent etre rattaches a des couts de transition (10%). Les postes dominants sont le corporate non alloue (616 M$) et les ajustements de purchase accounting (363 M$), soit 84%, qui sont structurels et sans lien avec la scission. Reformuler : 'l'ecart vient d'abord des charges corporate non allouees et de l'amortissement des incorporels d'acquisition ; les couts lies a la separation n'en representent qu'une fraction'.

controles.affirmation: La scission de l'ex-activite Biosciences vers Waters a 'entraine 450 M$ de depreciations non-cash' (resume)
controles.verbatim_source: Non-cash asset impairment charges of $450 million, relating to all of the Company's reportable segments, were charged to expense during the second quarter of fiscal year 2026 upon the Company's commitment to exit certain operational activities and projects which no longer align with and facilitate its current operational strategy, Excellence Unleashed.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q rattache explicitement les 450 M$ au programme de restructuration Excellence Unleashed (sortie d'activites et de projets), pas a la scission Waters. Reformuler : '450 M$ de depreciations non-cash passees au T2 FY2026 dans le cadre du programme Excellence Unleashed'.
